'''Floriana Football Club''' is a Maltese professional [[association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Floriana]] that currently plays in the [[Maltese Premier League]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://usa.laliga.es/en/news/laliga-the-best-show-in-malta-1 |title=LaLiga: The best show in Malta | News | Liga de Fútbol Profesional 2016 |access-date=29 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190716012832/https://usa.laliga.es/en/news/laliga-the-best-show-in-malta-1 |archive-date=16 July 2019 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Considered one of the most supported and successful clubs in Maltese football, Floriana has won 27 national league titles (Maltese record) and 21 FA trophies. It is also the only team from Malta to have qualified from the qualifying rounds to the first round proper of the UEFA Champions League, in the 1993–94 season.{{Citation needed|reason=Reliable source needed for the whole sentence|date=October 2022}}"}}
